items.reason_zh: Windows Core Messaging中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限。这会破坏关键的Windows通信框架，并可能导致未经授权的系统控制权。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Update Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. Since update mechanisms are frequently leveraged by attackers, patching reliability and service integrity are paramount.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update Service中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限。由于攻击者经常利用更新机制，补丁可靠性与服务完整性至关重要。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. This affects fundamental user-mode to kernel-mode transitions, posing a direct risk to system stability and security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Windows Win32 Kernel Subsystem中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限。这会影响基本的用户态到内核态转换，对系统稳定性和安全边界构成直接风险。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the Windows Codecs Library enables network-based remote code execution via malicious media files, making it a prime target for drive-by attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows Codecs Library中的整数溢出漏洞可通过恶意媒体文件实现基于网络的远程代码执行，使其成为旁路下载攻击的主要目标。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds write in the Windows PDF parser allows network-based remote code execution through malicious documents, frequently exploited in spear-phishing campaigns.
items.reason_zh: Windows PDF parser中的越界写入漏洞可通过恶意文档实现基于网络的远程代码执行，该漏洞常被用于鱼叉式网络钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: A heap-based buffer overflow in the PostScript Printer Driver facilitates network-based remote code execution via crafted print jobs, impacting nearly all Windows endpoints.
items.reason_zh: PostScript Printer Driver中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过构造的打印作业实现基于网络的远程代码执行，影响几乎所有Windows终端。

items.reason_en: An out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Office Excel permits network-based remote code execution via malicious spreadsheets, commonly abused in social engineering attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office Excel中的越界读取漏洞可通过恶意电子表格实现基于网络的远程代码执行，该漏洞常被滥用于社会工程学攻击。

items.reason_en: A critical path traversal flaw in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network-based code execution, severely compromising developer workstations and integrated cloud environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中的关键路径遍历缺陷允许未授权的网络代码执行，严重破坏开发工作站和集成云环境的安全。

items.reason_en: Electron fails to block compromised intermediate certificates across Chromium and Node.js stacks, increasing MITM risk for cross-platform desktop applications.
items.reason_zh: Electron未能跨Chromium和Node.js栈阻止受损的中间证书，增加了跨平台桌面应用的中间人攻击风险。

items.reason_en: A vulnerability in Oracle Java SE's 2D graphics component could allow attackers to compromise rendering-dependent enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Java SE的2D graphics组件中存在漏洞，可能使攻击者能够攻破依赖渲染的企业应用程序。

items.reason_en: Vulnerability in HP pre-installed agent software could allow local privilege escalation or arbitrary code execution on consumer desktops.
items.reason_zh: HP预装代理软件中的漏洞可能导致消费级桌面设备发生本地权限提升或任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Sandboxes apps can intercept drag-and-drop and clipboard data targeting other applications, breaching desktop isolation boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 沙盒应用可拦截针对其他应用程序的拖放和剪贴板数据，突破桌面隔离边界。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in GStreamer's RTP processing allows remote code execution when handling malicious media streams, compromising desktop multimedia applications.
items.reason_zh: GStreamer的RTP处理中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞在处理恶意媒体流时可导致远程代码执行，从而破坏桌面多媒体应用程序。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in NoMachine's mDNS handling enables unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening desktop remote access infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: NoMachine的mDNS处理中的基于堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接威胁桌面远程访问基础设施。

items.reason_en: Malicious sandboxed applications can bypass Flatpak isolation via the XDG Desktop Portal to access arbitrary host files, undermining modern desktop security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 恶意沙盒应用可通过XDG Desktop Portal绕过Flatpak隔离以访问任意主机文件，破坏现代桌面安全边界。

items.reason_en: A race condition in the Linux kernel's Bluetooth ISO connection handling can lead to reference count errors, potentially causing denial-of-service or memory corruption in core networking stacks.
items.reason_zh: Linux kernel中蓝牙ISO连接处理存在竞态条件，可能导致引用计数错误，进而引发核心网络栈的服务拒绝或内存损坏。

items.reason_en: Fixed buffer pool exhaustion in Zephyr's Bluetooth HCI USB transport enables remote denial of service on constrained IoT edge devices.
items.reason_zh: Zephyr的Bluetooth HCI USB transport中的固定缓冲区池耗尽漏洞可在受限IoT边缘设备上导致远程拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: OpenWrt's DHCPv6 parser reads beyond valid option boundaries due to truncated payloads, risking information disclosure or gateway crashes.
items.reason_zh: OpenWrt的DHCPv6 parser因载荷截断而读取超出有效选项边界的数据，可能导致信息泄露或网关崩溃。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated command injection in router firmware allows root-level execution during boot, compromising home network infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 路由器固件中的无需认证命令注入漏洞允许在启动期间以root权限执行代码，从而破坏家庭网络基础设施。

items.reason_en: Directory traversal in log download functionality enables attackers to read sensitive system files from biometric authentication hardware.
items.reason_zh: 日志下载功能中的目录遍历漏洞使攻击者能够读取生物识别认证硬件中的敏感系统文件。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in the Debug Service of Seetong surveillance devices allows unauthenticated remote access, with publicly available exploits targeting critical infrastructure monitoring.
items.reason_zh: Seetong监控设备调试服务中的身份验证缺陷允许无需认证的远程访问，且已有公开利用工具针对关键基础设施监控。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the Android Debug Bridge daemon (adbd) on DJI controllers grants unauthenticated shell access, serving as a direct foothold for root privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: DJI控制器上Android Debug Bridge守护进程（adbd）缺失身份验证机制，可导致无需认证的Shell访问，为提权至root提供直接跳板。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in a root-privileged helper allows local unprivileged processes to execute arbitrary commands by crafting malicious logcat entries, breaking device isolation.
items.reason_zh: 具有root权限的辅助程序中存在OS命令注入漏洞，攻击者可通过构造恶意的logcat条目使本地无特权进程执行任意命令，破坏设备隔离性。

items.reason_en: Unquoted hostname parameters in the Kiloview E3 encoder's device naming endpoint allow authenticated attackers to inject and execute arbitrary operating system commands.
items.reason_zh: Kiloview E3编码器设备命名端点中未加引号的主机名参数，允许已认证的攻击者注入并执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Malformed Publish Price Matrix commands in Silicon Labs EmberZNet trigger out-of-bounds writes, enabling remote code execution on affected Zigbee mesh network devices.
items.reason_zh: Silicon Labs EmberZNet中格式错误的Publish Price Matrix命令会触发越界写入，导致受影响的Zigbee网状网络设备发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center enables unauthenticated privilege escalation over the network, risking full administrative control of cloud tenants.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center中严重的证书验证缺陷可实现在网络层面无需认证的权限提升，危及云租户的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication for a critical function in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly exposing hosted applications to complete compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service中关键函数缺失身份验证机制，可导致无需认证的远程代码执行，直接使托管应用面临被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in the Azure SRE Agent permits network-based privilege escalation, potentially granting attackers elevated access to cloud infrastructure management tools.
items.reason_zh: Azure SRE Agent中缺失授权控制允许基于网络的权限提升，可能使攻击者获得对云基础设施管理工具的更高权限访问。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening backend data platforms and integrated services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse中对不可信数据的反序列化漏洞可导致无需认证的远程代码执行，威胁后端数据平台及集成服务。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud allows authorized attackers to execute arbitrary code within cloud workload orchestration environments.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud中的OS命令注入漏洞允许已授权的攻击者在云工作负载编排环境中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in the Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver breaks tenant isolation boundaries, risking lateral movement in containerized deployments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Container Isolation FS Filter Driver中的访问控制缺陷破坏了租户隔离边界，可能导致容器化部署中的横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Injection flaw in the Azure Storage Library enables privilege escalation during cloud storage operations, threatening data integrity and access controls.
items.reason_zh: Azure Storage Library中的注入缺陷可在云存储操作期间实现权限提升，威胁数据完整性与访问控制策略。

items.reason_en: Observable discrepancy in Active Directory Federation Services aids attackers in timing attacks or credential harvesting by leaking authentication state information.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services中可观测的差异会通过泄露认证状态信息，助长攻击者实施计时攻击或凭证窃取。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of communication channels in Azure Key Vault allows privilege escalation, risking compromise of centralized cryptographic key management.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault中通信通道限制不当可导致权限提升，危及集中式加密密钥管理的安全性。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Azure Key Vault enables security feature bypass, potentially allowing unauthorized actors to access sensitive secrets and certificates.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault中的弱身份验证机制可导致安全特性被绕过，可能使未授权实体访问敏感密钥和证书。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Azure Attestation service allows information disclosure over the network. Undermines cloud-based device health verification and zero-trust identity frameworks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Azure Attestation服务中的越界读取漏洞可导致网络层面的信息泄露，破坏基于云的设备健康验证及零信任身份框架。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Exchange Server facilitates unauthorized privilege escalation and potential compromise of enterprise email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的弱身份验证机制助长了未授权的权限提升，并可能导致企业邮件基础设施被攻陷。

items.reason_en: Double free in the Failover Cluster Virtual Driver enables remote code execution, directly threatening high-availability cloud and server infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Failover Cluster Virtual Driver中的双重释放漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接威胁高可用云及服务器基础设施。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in AD FS allows network spoofing, potentially breaking federated identity trust chains and enabling unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: AD FS中不当的证书验证机制允许网络欺骗，可能破坏联合身份信任链并导致未授权访问。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Configuration Manager permits privilege escalation across adjacent networks, risking centralized IT management and endpoint control.
items.reason_zh: Configuration Manager中的SQL注入漏洞允许跨相邻网络的权限提升，威胁集中式IT管理与终端控制。

items.reason_en: Information disclosure in Azure HDInsight exposes sensitive cluster configurations and credentials, risking multi-tenant data breaches in cloud analytics workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight中的信息泄露漏洞会暴露敏感的集群配置与凭据，危及云分析工作负载中的多租户数据安全。

items.reason_en: Origin validation failure in Microsoft Power Apps allows remote code execution, undermining cloud application security and enabling payload injection.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Power Apps中的源站验证失败漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏云应用安全性并允许载荷注入。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in AAD App Proxy enables unauthorized network-based privilege escalation, directly undermining cloud identity and access management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: AAD App Proxy中缺失身份验证机制可导致未授权的基于网络的权限提升，直接破坏云身份与访问管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in the Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service permits unauthorized network-based privilege escalation, risking full cluster compromise.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service中缺失身份验证机制允许未授权的基于网络的权限提升，危及整个集群的安全。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines allows unauthorized network-based code execution within CI/CD workflows, posing severe supply chain and deployment risks.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines中的命令注入漏洞允许未授权方在CI/CD工作流中执行基于网络的代码，带来严重的供应链与部署风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based code execution on cloud-hosted collaboration platforms, threatening tenant data integrity.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的路径遍历漏洞可在云托管协作平台上实现基于网络的代码执行，威胁租户数据完整性。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Exchange Online facilitates network-based remote code execution, directly impacting cloud email service availability and security.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Online中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现基于网络的远程代码执行，直接影响云邮件服务的可用性与安全性。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged attackers can compromise Oracle Identity Manager via HTTP REST endpoints, disrupting centralized enterprise authentication workflows.
items.reason_zh: 低权限攻击者可经由HTTP REST端点攻陷Oracle Identity Manager，破坏集中式企业身份认证工作流。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated Kruize Autotune REST API endpoints expose sensitive datasource configurations due to insecure default serialization.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的 Kruize Autotune REST API 端点因不安全的默认序列化机制，暴露了敏感的数据源配置。

items.reason_en: Path traversal during model archive extraction allows attackers to escape sandboxes and execute arbitrary code in cloud inference environments.
items.reason_zh: 模型归档文件解压过程中的路径遍历漏洞使攻击者能够逃逸沙箱环境，并在云推理环境中执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: SSH daemon vulnerability enables arbitrary code execution, potentially granting full administrative control over managed Kubernetes clusters.
items.reason_zh: SSH 守护进程漏洞可导致任意代码执行，可能使攻击者获得对托管 Kubernetes 集群的完全管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Overly broad RBAC permissions in the cluster operator allow compromised workloads to impersonate arbitrary users across the environment.
items.reason_zh: 集群操作器中过于宽泛的 RBAC 权限，使得被攻陷的工作负载能够在整个环境中冒充任意用户。

items.reason_en: GitHub Actions workflow remains vulnerable to Pwn Requests via issue_comment events, allowing attackers to inject and execute malicious code within CI/CD pipelines and centralized infrastructure repos.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Actions 工作流仍易受 issue_comment 事件触发的 Pwn Requests 攻击影响，允许攻击者在 CI/CD 流水线及集中式基础设施仓库中注入并执行恶意代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to OpenShift console devfile endpoints allows remote attackers to craft SSRF payloads that probe internal cluster services and exfiltrate sensitive configuration data.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证即可访问 OpenShift 控制台 devfile 端点，远程攻击者可构造 SSRF 载荷以探测内部集群服务并窃取敏感配置数据。

items.reason_en: Input validation flaws in the Okta Access Gateway Admin Console enable authenticated administrators to execute system commands within the service account context.
items.reason_zh: Okta Access Gateway 管理控制台的输入验证缺陷，可使已认证的管理员在服务账户上下文中执行系统命令。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DNS Server component allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, jeopardizing critical name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，危及关键名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft QUIC enables network-based remote code execution, impacting modern secure transport protocols used across enterprise networks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用基于网络的远程代码执行，影响企业网络中广泛使用的现代安全传输协议。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Network Policy Server permits unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising network access control and authentication gateways.
items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，破坏网络访问控制与身份验证网关。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, weakening secure communication channels at scale.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，大规模削弱安全通信通道。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in the Windows DHCP Server directly impacts critical network infrastructure and IP address management services.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的未经身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞直接影响关键网络基础设施和 IP 地址管理服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server enables complete network takeover if left unpatched, disrupting client connectivity and routing.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞若未及时修补，可导致完整的网络接管，中断客户端连接与路由。

items.reason_en: Missing reference handling in the SMB Server leads to resource exhaustion and denial of service for shared network file systems.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中缺失的引用处理机制会导致资源耗尽，并使共享网络文件系统遭受拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in DNS Server enables remote code execution, threatening the stability and availability of core infrastructure resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁核心基础设施解析服务的稳定性与可用性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DHCP Server allows remote code execution, risking unauthorized control over IP address management and network segmentation policies.
items.reason_zh: DHCP Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，可能导致未经授权的控制权获取，危及 IP 地址管理与网络分段策略。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in RRAS grants attackers unauthorized machine access, compromising network routing, NAT, and VPN gateway functions.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 中的远程代码执行漏洞使攻击者能够未经授权访问计算机，破坏网络路由、NAT 和 VPN 网关功能。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services permits remote code execution, directly endangering identity management and domain trust relationships.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的授权错误漏洞允许远程代码执行，直接危及身份管理与域信任关系。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables remote code execution over the network. Compromises critical network infrastructure and can lead to full subnet takeover.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。该漏洞会破坏关键网络基础设施，并可能导致整个子网被接管。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Active Directory Domain Services allows denial of service over the network. Directly impacts core authentication services and enterprise network availability.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 中的越界读取漏洞允许通过网络实施拒绝服务攻击。直接波及核心身份验证服务与企业网络可用性。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows iSCSI initiator allows remote code execution over network storage protocols, disrupting enterprise SAN operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 发起程序中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络存储协议进行远程代码执行，破坏企业 SAN 运营。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows iSCSI also enables remote code execution, compounding storage infrastructure risks and availability concerns.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用漏洞同样可导致远程代码执行，进一步加剧存储基础设施风险与可用性隐患。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in RRAS exposes sensitive network routing information to unauthorized remote attackers, aiding reconnaissance and pivoting.
items.reason_zh: RRAS 中的越界读取漏洞向未经授权的攻击者泄露敏感的网络路由信息，助长其侦察与横向移动行为。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in NDES can trigger denial of service conditions, impacting network device enrollment reliability and onboarding workflows.
items.reason_zh: NDES 中的越界读取漏洞可能触发拒绝服务状况，影响网络设备注册可靠性与入职配置流程。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in DNS Server allows remote code execution, jeopardizing core name resolution infrastructure and enabling cache poisoning or traffic redirection.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的类型混淆漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及核心名称解析基础设施，并可导致缓存投毒或流量重定向。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in OpenSSH for Windows enables remote code execution, compromising secure shell access and backend network administration tools.
items.reason_zh: Windows 版 OpenSSH 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，破坏安全 Shell 访问权限与后端网络管理工具。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Remote Desktop Gateway Service permits remote code execution, exposing gateway appliances to unauthorized session hijacking and network pivoting.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Gateway Service 中的释放后使用漏洞允许远程代码执行，使网关设备面临未经授权的回话劫持与网络横向移动风险。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in AD FS allows network spoofing attacks, undermining federated identity management and enabling unauthorized access to protected resources.
items.reason_zh: AD FS 中的弱身份验证漏洞允许网络欺骗攻击，破坏联合身份管理，并使攻击者能够未经授权访问受保护的资源。

items.reason_en: Critical integer underflow in Windows DNS Server allows unauthenticated remote code execution. This threatens core network resolution infrastructure and can lead to full domain compromise.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的严重整数下溢漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。该漏洞威胁核心网络解析基础设施，并可能导致整个域被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Type confusion vulnerability in DNS Server enables unauthenticated remote code execution. Exploitation risks widespread network disruption and unauthorized control over name resolution services.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的类型混淆漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行。利用该漏洞可能导致广泛的网络中断，并使攻击者获得对名称解析服务的未授权控制。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows DHCP Server allows local privilege escalation. Compromising this service can disrupt IP address management and network connectivity across segments.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升。利用该服务可破坏跨网段的 IP 地址管理与网络连接。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows iSCSI allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. Storage area network protocols require strict isolation to prevent full storage compromise and data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Windows iSCSI 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。存储区域网络协议需要严格的隔离机制，以防止存储系统完全沦陷和数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Use after free in DNS Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. DNS is foundational infrastructure, and remote code execution poses severe routing, resolution, and availability risks.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。DNS 是基础架构，远程代码执行会带来严重的路由、解析和可用性风险。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in Windows DHCP Server allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. DHCP controls dynamic IP allocation, and exploitation could disrupt network connectivity or facilitate man-in-the-middle attacks.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的越界写入漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。DHCP 负责动态 IP 分配，利用该漏洞可能破坏网络连接或辅助中间人攻击。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows TCP/IP allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. Flaws in the core networking stack directly impact all network communications and protocol handling.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。核心网络栈的缺陷会直接影响所有网络通信与协议处理。

items.reason_en: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling in Windows SMB Server allows an unauthorized attacker to deny service over a network. SMB availability is critical for file sharing, and resource exhaustion can halt enterprise operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB Server 中资源分配缺乏限制或节流机制，允许未授权攻击者通过网络拒绝服务。SMB 的可用性对文件共享至关重要，资源耗尽可能导致企业运营中断。

items.reason_en: Access of resource using incompatible type in Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. Socket driver vulnerabilities can bypass network filtering logic and lead to privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock 中使用不兼容类型访问资源漏洞允许已授权攻击者在本地提升权限。套接字驱动程序的漏洞可绕过网络过滤逻辑并导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the TOTOLINK X2000R firmware upload module allows authenticated network-based remote code execution, fully compromising router control.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK X2000R 固件上传模块中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络进行远程代码执行，从而完全接管路由器控制权。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the batch upgrade functionality enables authenticated network-based remote code execution, facilitating persistent device takeover.
items.reason_zh: 批量升级功能中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络进行远程代码执行，从而实现设备的持久化接管。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in the password setup functionality permits authenticated network-based remote code execution, bypassing fundamental security configurations.
items.reason_zh: 密码设置功能中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许经过身份验证的攻击者通过网络进行远程代码执行，从而绕过基本安全配置。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the Mcli functionality allows authenticated network-based remote code execution via specially crafted HTTP requests.
items.reason_zh: Mcli 功能中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过特制的 HTTP 请求进行经过身份验证的网络远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in the batchupg functionality enables authenticated network-based remote code execution, critical for securing home and SMB networking equipment.
items.reason_zh: batchupg 功能中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许经过身份验证的网络远程代码执行，这对保障家庭和企业级网络设备的安全至关重要。

items.reason_en: Authenticated stack-based buffer overflow in Totolink router web UI firmware directly leads to arbitrary code execution on consumer networking hardware.
items.reason_zh: Totolink 路由器 Web UI 固件中的经过身份验证的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可直接在消费级网络设备硬件上导致任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited vulnerability in VeloCloud Orchestrator allows remote attackers to access privileged internal functions, jeopardizing SD-WAN infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: VeloCloud Orchestrator 中被主动利用的漏洞允许远程攻击者访问特权内部功能，危及 SD-WAN 基础设施。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated command injection in HPE Aruba's PAPI management protocol enables immediate remote code execution on enterprise wireless controllers.
items.reason_zh: HPE Aruba 的 PAPI 管理协议中存在未授权命令注入漏洞，可在企业无线控制器上立即实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical buffer overflow in AOS-10 enables unauthenticated remote code execution, leading to complete controller compromise.
items.reason_zh: AOS-10 中的严重缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未授权远程代码执行，导致控制器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to execute root commands on AOS-8 network controllers.
items.reason_zh: 身份验证绕过缺陷允许未授权攻击者在 AOS-8 网络控制器上执行 root 命令。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated SQL injection in AOS-8 permits direct database manipulation and subsequent remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: AOS-8 中的未授权 SQL 注入漏洞允许直接操作数据库并随后实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: The experimental magick plugin in Apache Traffic Server allows unauthenticated clients to control ImageMagick arguments, leading to remote code execution on high-throughput proxy servers.
items.reason_zh: Apache Traffic Server 中的实验性 magick 插件允许未授权客户端控制 ImageMagick 参数，从而导致高吞吐量代理服务器上发生远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in OpenWrt's odhcpd DHCPv6 response handler can be triggered by crafted network requests, potentially allowing remote code execution on edge routers.
items.reason_zh: OpenWrt 的 odhcpd DHCPv6 响应处理器中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可通过特制的网络请求触发，潜在地允许在边缘路由器上执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to the tsmemcache plugin exposes the shared proxy cache to network read, write, and deletion operations, severely impacting data integrity and service availability.
items.reason_zh: 对 tsmemcache 插件的未授权访问使共享代理缓存暴露于网络读写及删除操作之下，严重损害数据完整性与服务可用性。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication mechanisms in ASUS routers allow nearby attackers to forge access tickets and perform unauthorized administrative operations.
items.reason_zh: ASUS 路由器中的身份验证机制不当允许附近攻击者伪造访问凭证并执行未授权的后台管理操作。

items.reason_en: Combined CSRF and OS command injection vulnerabilities in ASUS router firmware trick logged-in administrators into executing arbitrary commands with root privileges.
items.reason_zh: ASUS 路由器固件中结合的 CSRF 与操作系统命令注入漏洞可诱骗已登录的管理员以 root 权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the snap7 S7 microclient allows impersonated PLCs to overflow buffers via unchecked length fields, threatening factory automation networks.
items.reason_zh: snap7 S7 microclient 中的越界写入漏洞允许伪装成 PLC 的设备通过未检查的长度字段溢出缓冲区，威胁工厂自动化网络。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in passive PLC communication mode allows malicious peers to overflow buffers and disrupt industrial operations.
items.reason_zh: 被动 PLC 通信模式下的越界写入漏洞允许恶意对等节点溢出缓冲区并破坏工业运行。

items.reason_en: Dynamic module importing in the CGM CLININET RunCGI.pm component allows adjacent network attackers to supply crafted query parameters and execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
items.reason_zh: CGM CLININET RunCGI.pm 组件中的动态模块导入漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者提供特制的查询参数并以提升的权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Unrestricted backend function calls in Postiz allow authenticated users to invoke internal helpers, leading to potential data exfiltration and application logic bypass.
items.reason_zh: Postiz 中不受限制的后台函数调用允许已认证用户调用内部辅助函数，可能导致数据外泄及应用逻辑绕过。

items.reason_en: Buffer overflow in the widely deployed Google Brotli decoder permits memory corruption and remote code execution, affecting numerous web servers and clients relying on compression.
items.reason_zh: 广泛部署的 Google Brotli 解码器中存在缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致内存损坏和远程代码执行，影响众多依赖压缩技术的 Web 服务器与客户端。

items.reason_en: Improper control of code generation in ASP.NET Core enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly impacting modern web application frameworks.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中代码生成控制不当允许未经身份验证的网络远程代码执行，直接影响现代 Web 应用框架。

items.reason_en: Double free vulnerability in Internet Information Services (IIS) allows unauthenticated denial of service over the network, disrupting critical web hosting infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Internet Information Services (IIS) 中的双重释放漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络拒绝服务，破坏关键的 Web 托管基础设施。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages viewed by end users.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许攻击者向终端用户查看的网页中注入恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Reliance on untrusted inputs in PowerShell security decisions enables remote code execution during automated script execution or scheduled tasks.
items.reason_zh: PowerShell 安全决策依赖不受信任的输入，可在自动脚本执行或计划任务期间导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in ASP.NET Core causes application crashes and denial of service for web services depending on the framework.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的越界写入会导致应用程序崩溃，并使依赖该框架的 Web 服务遭受拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows traffic tampering and cache poisoning, severely undermining web application integrity and user sessions.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私可导致流量篡改和缓存投毒，严重破坏 Web 应用完整性及用户会话。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server facilitates spoofing attacks over the network, enabling credential theft and malicious email manipulation.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞便于网络欺骗攻击，可实现凭证窃取和恶意邮件操纵。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in SharePoint allows privilege escalation, potentially exposing internal resources and enabling lateral movement within corporate networks.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可导致权限提升，可能暴露内部资源并支持在企业网络内进行横向移动。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables spoofing and session hijacking over the network. Poses significant risk to enterprise collaboration and document management platforms.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞可引发网络欺骗与会话劫持。对企业协作与文档管理平台构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Internet Information Services allows local privilege escalation. Threatens web server integrity and can be chained with other vectors for full system compromise.
items.reason_zh: Internet Information Services 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升。威胁 Web 服务器完整性，且可与其他利用向量结合以实现系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core can bypass security controls and redirect traffic, undermining application integrity and session management.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私可绕过安全控制并重定向流量，破坏应用完整性与会话管理。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint allows authenticated users to escalate privileges and access restricted administrative functions without proper validation.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失的授权检查允许已认证用户提升权限，并在未经适当验证的情况下访问受限的管理功能。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint enables remote code execution by exploiting insecure object reconstruction during document handling.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中对不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞可通过利用文档处理期间不安全的对象重建实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint allows attackers to manipulate backend databases, leading to privilege escalation and sensitive data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许攻击者操纵后端数据库，导致权限提升和敏感数据外泄。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in IIS permits remote code execution over the network, making internet-facing web servers highly vulnerable to immediate exploitation.
items.reason_zh: IIS 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行，使面向互联网的 Web 服务器极易受到即时利用。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in .NET allows remote code execution when processing untrusted data, a critical risk for modern web frameworks and API endpoints.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的不安全反序列化在处理不受信任数据时允许远程代码执行，对现代 Web 框架和 API 端点构成关键风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SharePoint enables remote code execution, allowing attackers to bypass directory restrictions and deploy malicious payloads on web servers.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可实现远程代码执行，允许攻击者绕过目录限制并在 Web 服务器上部署恶意载荷。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure AI Foundry allows authorized network-based privilege escalation, exposing internal web resources from AI development platforms.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Foundry 中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许基于网络的权限提升，暴露 AI 开发平台的内部 Web 资源。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Visual Studio Code enables network-based security feature bypass, weakening protections for web development environments.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中缺失的授权检查可实现基于网络的安全功能绕过，削弱 Web 开发环境的保护。

items.reason_en: Improper path equivalence resolution in Visual Studio Code facilitates network-based security feature bypass, complicating secure handling of web assets.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中不当的路径等价解析有助于实现基于网络的安全功能绕过，增加 Web 资产安全处理的难度。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Visual Studio Code allows network-based security feature bypass locally, affecting isolated web project execution.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中错误的授权检查允许在本地绕过基于网络的安全功能，影响隔离 Web 项目的执行。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited OS command injection in Collabora Online's CODE server proxy enables remote code execution in collaborative document environments.
items.reason_zh: Collabora Online 的 CODE 服务器代理中存在被主动利用的操作系统命令注入漏洞，可在协同文档环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated path traversal in FineReport's SVG design endpoint allows arbitrary file writes, leading to complete web application compromise.
items.reason_zh: FineReport 的 SVG 设计端点存在未授权路径遍历漏洞，允许任意文件写入，导致 Web 应用被完全攻陷。

items.reason_en: Regex capture variable misuse in F5 NGINX map directives triggers crashes or potential exploitation in high-traffic reverse proxy deployments.
items.reason_zh: F5 NGINX map 指令中正则捕获变量误用会在高流量反向代理部署中触发崩溃或潜在利用。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded HMAC signing key enables JWT forgery, allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative CMS access.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码的 HMAC 签名密钥可导致 JWT 伪造，使未认证攻击者能够获取 CMS 管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Missing file extension validation in a WordPress plugin allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts.
items.reason_zh: WordPress 插件中缺失的文件扩展名验证允许未认证攻击者上传并执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Flawed password reset mechanism forces credential changes for any user without verification, facilitating account takeover.
items.reason_zh: 有缺陷的密码重置机制在未经验证的情况下强制更改任何用户的凭据，助长账户接管。

items.reason_en: Unprotected configuration rollback endpoint allows attackers to modify IP whitelists and bypass network restrictions.
items.reason_zh: 未受保护的配置回滚端点允许攻击者修改 IP 白名单并绕过网络限制。

items.reason_en: Improper token storage in magic link authentication enables attackers to forge verification links and hijack user accounts.
items.reason_zh: 魔法链接身份验证中不当的令牌存储使攻击者能够伪造验证链接并劫持用户账户。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data allows object injection, leading to arbitrary code execution on affected websites.
items.reason_zh: 对不受信任数据的不安全反序列化可导致对象注入，进而引发受影响网站上的任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in ThemeREX ZenSoul permits object injection, enabling remote attackers to achieve arbitrary code execution in widely deployed WordPress environments.
items.reason_zh: ThemeREX ZenSoul 中对不受信任数据的反序列化允许对象注入，使远程攻击者能够在广泛部署的 WordPress 环境中实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: IIIF Auth endpoints in Goobi Viewer accept an unvalidated origin parameter, facilitating cross-origin request forgery and unauthorized data embedding in digital library platforms.
items.reason_zh: Goobi Viewer 中的 IIIF Auth 端点接受未经验证的 origin 参数，便于在数字图书馆平台中进行跨域请求伪造和未经授权的数据嵌入。

items.reason_en: Authenticated stored XSS via HTML attribute injection in Phoca Gallery allows malicious JavaScript execution in Joomla sites, compromising administrator and user sessions.
items.reason_zh: 在Phoca Gallery中通过HTML属性注入的已认证存储型XSS漏洞，允许在Joomla站点中执行恶意JavaScript代码，导致管理员与用户会话被破坏。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in the WordPress Participants Database plugin permits object injection attacks, allowing unauthenticated threat actors to execute arbitrary code or escalate privileges.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Participants Database插件中的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可触发对象注入攻击，使未授权攻击者得以执行任意代码或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the onPhase frevvo registration form enables remote attackers to assume tenant admin privileges and execute operating system commands via manipulated form submissions.
items.reason_zh: onPhase frevvo注册表单的身份验证绕过漏洞使远程攻击者能够获取租户管理员权限，并通过构造恶意表单提交执行操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in .NET and Visual Studio allows unauthenticated remote privilege escalation over the network, undermining runtime security boundaries for enterprise applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET与Visual Studio中的类型混淆漏洞允许攻击者通过网络进行未认证的远程提权，从而破坏企业应用程序的运行时安全边界。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Dynamics Business Central enables network-based privilege escalation, potentially exposing sensitive business data and configuration files.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中的路径遍历漏洞可支持基于网络的提权操作，可能导致敏感业务数据与配置文件泄露。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Dynamics Business Central permits network-based remote code execution, threatening enterprise resource planning middleware.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics Business Central中存在的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，对企业资源规划中间件构成严重威胁。

items.reason_en: Improper input validation in the .NET Framework allows network-based tampering, compromising data integrity for applications relying on framework-level security checks.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中存在的输入验证缺陷可导致基于网络的篡改行为，破坏依赖框架级安全检查的应用程序的数据完整性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening database server stability and data confidentiality.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接危及数据库服务器的稳定性与数据机密性。

items.reason_en: SQL injection in Configuration Manager allows privilege escalation, risking unauthorized control over enterprise device management and software deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Configuration Manager中的SQL注入漏洞可导致提权，进而引发对企业管理设备及软件部署流水线的未授权控制风险。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution over the network. Critical risk to enterprise data layers where attackers can execute arbitrary commands without authentication.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中存在的不信任数据反序列化漏洞可导致网络远程代码执行。该漏洞对企业数据层构成重大风险，攻击者无需认证即可执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the .NET runtime enables remote code execution, destabilizing backend application servers and microservices architectures.
items.reason_zh: .NET运行时中的越界写入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，进而破坏后端应用服务器与微服务架构的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Improperly implemented security checks in .NET allow remote code execution by bypassing standard input validations and sandbox boundaries.
items.reason_zh: .NET中安全校验机制的实现缺陷可通过绕过标准输入验证与沙箱边界导致远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in .NET permits local privilege escalation by accessing restricted files outside intended directories during runtime operations.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的路径遍历漏洞允许在运行时访问预期目录之外的受限文件，从而导致本地提权。

items.reason_en: Link following vulnerability in .NET allows local privilege escalation through manipulated file paths, compromising middleware isolation guarantees.
items.reason_zh: .NET中的链接跟随漏洞允许攻击者通过操纵文件路径实现本地提权，从而破坏中间件的隔离保障。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables remote code execution, directly threatening enterprise data repositories and allowing complete database takeover.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致远程代码执行，直接危及企业数据存储库，并使攻击者能够完全接管数据库。

items.reason_en: Network-accessible heap overflow in SQL Server facilitates privilege escalation, compromising database integrity and enabling unauthorized administrative actions.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中可通过网络触发的堆溢出漏洞可导致提权，破坏数据库完整性并允许执行未授权的后台管理操作。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. SQL Server remains a primary target for enterprise data breaches, making remote code execution particularly dangerous.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码。鉴于SQL Server仍是企业数据泄露的首要目标，此类远程代码执行风险尤为致命。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in SQLite allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. SQLite's ubiquity across applications and embedded systems makes memory corruption risks highly consequential.
items.reason_zh: SQLite中的越界读取漏洞允许已认证的攻击者实现本地提权。由于SQLite广泛应用于各类应用与嵌入式系统，其引发的内存损坏风险后果极为严重。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET allows an unauthorized attacker to deny service over a network. Runtime performance degradation can cause widespread application outages and service disruptions.
items.reason_zh: .NET中存在的算法复杂度缺陷可导致未授权攻击者通过网络实施拒绝服务攻击。运行时性能劣化将引发大规模应用宕机与服务中断。

items.reason_en: Double free in Windows Libarchive allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. Libarchive is widely integrated into backup, compression, and middleware tools, expanding the potential attack surface.
items.reason_zh: Windows Libarchive中的双重释放漏洞允许未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。由于Libarchive广泛集成于备份、压缩及中间件工具中，该漏洞显著扩大了潜在攻击面。

items.reason_en: A stack-based buffer overflow in SQL Server enables network-based privilege escalation, directly threatening the core relational database engine.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞可支持基于网络的提权操作，直接危及核心关系型数据库引擎的安全。

items.reason_en: Code injection in SQL Server Management Studio and VSTO allows network-based remote code execution, compromising database administration and development toolchains.
items.reason_zh: SQL Server Management Studio与VSTO中的代码注入漏洞可导致基于网络的远程代码执行，从而破坏数据库管理与开发工具链的安全性。

items.reason_en: An untrusted search path flaw in the .NET Framework permits local security feature bypass, increasing susceptibility to DLL hijacking in middleware deployments.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework中不受信任的搜索路径缺陷可导致本地安全机制被绕过，增加了中间件部署环境遭受DLL劫持的风险。

items.reason_en: Lack of resource throttling in ASP.NET Core enables network-based denial of service, degrading web application performance and availability.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中缺失的资源限流机制可导致基于网络的拒绝服务攻击，进而削弱Web应用的性能与可用性。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass and credential exposure in Apache Pulsar Manager grants unauthorized administrative control over distributed message brokers.
items.reason_zh: Apache Pulsar Manager中存在的关键身份验证绕过与凭据泄露漏洞，可使攻击者获得对分布式消息代理的未授权后台管理控制权。

items.reason_en: Improper validation of shadow topic source properties in Apache Pulsar allows unauthorized data replication between managed ledgers.
items.reason_zh: Apache Pulsar中对影子主题源属性的验证缺陷可导致托管账本间发生未授权的数据复制。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated JDBC injection allows attackers to establish arbitrary database connections and manipulate backend data stores.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的JDBC注入漏洞允许攻击者建立任意数据库连接，进而操纵后端数据存储。

items.reason_en: Authenticated SQL injection via undocumented formula arguments enables direct manipulation of the underlying PostgreSQL database.
items.reason_zh: 利用未公开文档的公式参数发起的已认证SQL注入漏洞，可直接操纵底层PostgreSQL数据库。

items.reason_en: Incomplete path traversal fix allows attackers with storage access to overwrite arbitrary files, compromising database backup integrity.
items.reason_zh: 针对路径遍历漏洞的不完整修复，使得具备存储访问权限的攻击者能够覆盖任意文件，从而破坏数据库备份的完整性。

items.reason_en: Incorrectly reset global state in PHP may reference freed request memory, causing subsequent requests to branch on uninitialized data and leading to unpredictable runtime behavior or crashes.
items.reason_zh: PHP中全局状态的重置缺陷可能导致引用已释放的请求内存，致使后续请求基于未初始化数据进行逻辑分支，进而引发不可预知的运行时异常或崩溃。

items.reason_en: Easily exploitable HTTP vulnerability in Oracle Essbase's security component allows low-privileged attackers to compromise enterprise analytics platforms, risking sensitive business data.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Essbase 安全组件中存在易于利用的 HTTP 漏洞，低权限攻击者可借此破坏企业分析平台，导致敏感业务数据面临风险。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation via the dnscache package in Zimbra allows the zimbra user to execute commands as root through an unrestricted sudo policy, breaking application isolation.
items.reason_zh: Zimbra 中的 dnscache 包存在本地提权漏洞，zimbra 用户可通过不受限制的 sudo 策略以 root 身份执行命令，破坏应用隔离性。

items.reason_en: An easily exploitable unauthenticated HTTP vulnerability in Oracle JD Edwards Orchestrator allows remote attackers to fully compromise the enterprise application environment.
items.reason_zh: Oracle JD Edwards Orchestrator 中存在易于利用的未认证 HTTP 漏洞，远程攻击者可借此完全控制企业应用程序环境。

items.reason_en: Splunk Enterprise users lacking admin roles can derive the PostgreSQL sidecar database superuser password, subsequently running arbitrary operating system commands on search head clusters.
items.reason_zh: 缺乏管理员角色的 Splunk Enterprise 用户可推导出 PostgreSQL sidecar 数据库超级用户密码，进而在搜索头集群上执行任意操作系统命令。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass via user-controlled keys in Microsoft Bookings enables unauthenticated privilege escalation over the network, undermining identity and access management controls.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bookings 中通过用户可控密钥可实现授权绕过，使网络上的未认证提权成为可能，削弱身份与访问管理控制措施。

items.reason_en: Improper path resolution in Windows SmartScreen allows network-based security feature bypass, reducing protection against malicious downloads and phishing attempts.
items.reason_zh: Windows SmartScreen 中的路径解析不当可导致基于网络的防御功能被绕过，降低对恶意下载和钓鱼攻击的防护能力。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Windows Schannel enables network-based spoofing attacks, weakening TLS handshake verification and exposing communications to interception.
items.reason_zh: Windows Schannel 中的证书验证不当可导致基于网络的欺骗攻击，削弱 TLS 握手验证并暴露通信内容以防窃听。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Virtualization-Based Security (VBS) Enclave permits local privilege escalation, potentially undermining hardware-assisted isolation mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 基于虚拟化的安全（VBS）Enclave 中存在不可信指针解引用漏洞，可导致本地提权，可能破坏硬件辅助隔离机制。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in .NET allows remote code execution over a network, impacting a vast ecosystem of cross-platform and legacy applications.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中对不可信数据的反序列化可导致通过网络执行的远程代码执行，影响庞大的跨平台和遗留应用程序生态系统。

items.reason_en: Deserialization flaw in .NET Framework enables remote code execution, remaining a critical exploitation vector for older Windows server workloads.
items.reason_zh: .NET Framework 中的反序列化缺陷可导致远程代码执行，仍是旧版 Windows 服务器工作负载的关键利用途径。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in Python allows local privilege escalation, affecting cross-platform development environments and automated deployment pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Python 中的权限管理不当可导致本地提权，影响跨平台开发环境和自动化部署流水线。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Windows Update allows local privilege escalation. This undermines patch management integrity and could allow attackers to bypass security controls during updates.
items.reason_zh: Windows Update 中存在命令注入漏洞，可导致本地提权。该漏洞破坏了补丁管理完整性，并可能使攻击者在更新期间绕过安全控制。

items.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in Windows Key Distribution Center weakens Kerberos authentication. This significantly increases the risk of credential theft and lateral movement within Active Directory environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Key Distribution Center 中的加密签名验证绕过会削弱 Kerberos 身份验证，显著增加 Active Directory 环境中凭证窃取和横向移动的风险。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Subsystem for Linux allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. WSL bridges two operating system ecosystems, creating unique attack surfaces for developer environments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Subsystem for Linux 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可使授权攻击者实现本地提权。WSL 桥接了两个操作系统生态，为开发者环境带来了独特的攻击面。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Remote Desktop Client allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code over a network. Remote access clients are frequently targeted for initial access and session hijacking attempts.
items.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可使未授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。远程访问客户端常成为初始访问和会话劫持攻击的目标。

items.reason_en: Use after free in Windows Cryptographic Services allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. Compromising crypto services undermines encryption integrity and breaks secure communication channels.
items.reason_zh: Windows Cryptographic Services 中的释放后使用漏洞可使授权攻击者通过网络执行代码。攻破加密服务会破坏加密完整性并中断安全通信通道。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally. File system drivers handle sensitive data storage, and corruption risks can extend to disk-level exploitation and data integrity loss.
items.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可使授权攻击者实现本地提权。文件系统驱动程序负责敏感数据存储，损坏风险可能蔓延至磁盘级利用和数据完整性丢失。

items.reason_en: Wasmtime's Cranelift backend incorrectly calculates branch targets for large instruction tables, potentially breaking sandbox isolation in WebAssembly runtimes.
items.reason_zh: Wasmtime 的 Cranelift 后端在计算大型指令表的分支目标时存在错误，可能破坏 WebAssembly 运行时的沙箱隔离。

items.reason_en: Exponential backtracking in Mistune's markdown inline link parser enables unauthenticated denial of service in content processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: Mistune 的 Markdown 行内链接解析器存在指数级回溯漏洞，可在内容处理流水线中引发未认证的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization via malicious dataset files enables arbitrary Python code execution, threatening machine learning pipeline security.
items.reason_zh: 通过恶意数据集文件进行的不安全反序列化可导致任意 Python 代码执行，威胁机器学习流水线的安全。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization check allows non-admin users to decrypt and expose backend SSH private keys, compromising infrastructure access.
items.reason_zh: 缺失授权检查允许非管理员用户解密并泄露后端 SSH 私钥，从而危及基础设施访问权限。

items.reason_en: Compiler scope resolution errors in smart contracts can cause unexpected variable overwrites, risking financial loss in DeFi applications.
items.reason_zh: 智能合约中的编译器作用域解析错误可能导致意外的变量覆盖，引发 DeFi 应用的资金损失风险。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated FastAPI deployment surface in PraisonAI exposes chat routes that directly invoke agent functions, allowing remote attackers to execute arbitrary AI agent actions.
items.reason_zh: PraisonAI 中未认证的 FastAPI 部署表面暴露了直接调用代理功能的聊天路由，使远程攻击者能够执行任意 AI 代理操作。

items.reason_en: Storage slot allocation overlap in Vyper corrupts contract state when nonreentrant locks overwrite variables, posing severe financial and operational risks to deployed smart contracts.
items.reason_zh: Vyper 中的存储槽分配重叠会在非重入锁覆盖变量时损坏合约状态，对已部署的智能合约构成严重的财务和运营风险。

items.reason_en: Command execution vulnerability in Aider allows attackers to run shell commands by committing a malicious configuration file, exploiting auto-loading features in AI-assisted development workflows.
items.reason_zh: Aider 中的命令执行漏洞允许攻击者通过提交恶意配置文件运行 Shell 命令，利用了 AI 辅助开发工作流中的自动加载特性。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in the agentjido req_llm WebSocket client allows on-path attackers to intercept and modify OpenAI session tokens by exploiting untrusted TLS certificates.
items.reason_zh: agentjido req_llm WebSocket 客户端中的证书验证不当，使中间人攻击者能够通过利用不受信任的 TLS 证书拦截和修改 OpenAI 会话令牌。

items.reason_en: GitLab's OmniAuth SAML and LDAP auto-linking feature can be abused by authenticated users to take over existing LDAP-backed accounts without interaction, compromising identity management workflows.
items.reason_zh: GitLab 的 OmniAuth SAML 和 LDAP 自动关联功能可被已认证用户滥用，无需交互即可接管现有的 LDAP 支持账户，破坏身份管理工作流。
